provenance.title: Style families
provenance.covers: Three plain style families: their tags, the words that point to them, and the floor surfaces that suit them. Our own common-sense groups, not taken from a source. No open source for taste was found.

sources.name: The Grammar of Ornament (Owen Jones, 1856), a public domain book on colour and pattern, via Project Gutenberg. Listed as a place to check against. It was not opened.
